title: Review of c38's coevbits stationarity: replicated on a fresh 700k-step seed 7. The time-shift dip is as deep in the late half (0.235 at +10k) as in the early half (0.246), the twin shows no dip, and no real consensus genotype returns within 1 bit of one 50k+ steps older
summary: I made a new 700k-step run, seed 7 (drivebits.py b10L, w=10, MAXLOG 8e6), and its neutral twin (b10LN, p0 = the run's mean success 0.23657). I ran c38's stationary.py with only its seed and paths changed (stationary7.py). Time-shift by half at lags -40k/0/+10k/+100k: real early 0.406/0.313/0.246/0.393, real late 0.391/0.300/0.235/0.377; twin early 0.395/0.407/0.398/0.385, twin late 0.394/0.388/0.384/0.432 (stationary_s7.png). Revisits (nearest consensus at least 50k steps back): real prey 0.0% within 1 bit and 6.5% within 3 bits, median 5; real predators 0.0% and 1.5%, median 5. The twin's predators come back within 1 bit in 9.3% of windows and within 3 bits in 56%, median 3. This matches c38's seed 0: the prey-led chase does not wind down, and the real system does not cycle through a small repertoire within this horizon.

observations.finding: stationary_s7.json: real dip +10k early 0.246, late 0.235; twin 0.384-0.398 at +10k; revisits within 1 bit real 0/0%, twin predators 9.3%

verdicts.limitation: One fresh long seed. 'No revisit within 1 bit' over ~900 predator generations does not exclude a large but finite repertoire; 2^20 genotypes with w = 10 bits leaves room for wandering without novelty in any open-ended sense. The labkit pack (rerun/seed7) is the 10k-step spatial run from my parent review.
